title: Henry M NDE 20315
content:
I was cleaning the undercarriage of a car and it fell off the jack stand. It fell on me and the pinch weld hit my head and knocked me out. I was aware of the car falling then I felt a bump, like a mall rock hitting my head and then I got up. It was like colors were more than colors. It looked like I could touch them, it felt like the air was silk sheets moving over my body. I felt like I was being watched, and I looked around and saw no one. I then turned around and saw my head bleeding. Then I felt like I was falling and then I was back in my body. My wife soon after, came out screaming for the amount of blood coming out of my head. She drove me to the hospital where I had a minor skull fracture, and I needed six stitches. Other than that I was fine.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described intensified perception: 'colors were more than colors... I could touch them' and 'the air was silk sheets moving over my body'; felt watched; then 'felt like I was falling' before being back in body.

environment.environment_other_detail: Perception described as hyper-vivid/tactile: colors seemed touchable; air felt like 'silk sheets moving over my body.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt like falling and then was back in body ('Then I felt like I was falling and then I was back in my body').

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car fell off jack stand; pinch weld hit head and knocked him out.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heightened sensory perception and feeling watched; 'falling' sensation preceding return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Became aware of accident, then got up with hyper-vivid perception, saw head bleeding, then felt falling and was back in body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Hyper-tactile perception of colors and air ('colors were more than colors... could touch them'; 'air was silk sheets'); sense of being watched with no one seen.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It was like colors were more than colors. It looked like I could touch them, it felt like the air was silk sheets moving over my body.”; “I felt like I was being watched, and I looked around and saw no one.”; “Then I felt like I was falling and then I was back in my body.”
